import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_62/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # We expect columns: ['Text Date', 'Value Date', 'Zip Code', 'Water Use', 'Power Use']
        # We will use 'Text Date' as the Month column in target
        # Aggregate by 'Text Date' summing Water Use and Power Use

        # Convert Water Use to float (in case of any issues)
        df['Water Use'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Water Use'], errors='coerce')
        # Convert Power Use to integer (coerce errors, then fillna with 0 and convert)
        df['Power Use'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Power Use'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

        # Group by 'Text Date' and aggregate Water Use (sum) and Power Use (sum)
        grouped = df.groupby('Text Date', as_index=False).agg({
            'Water Use': 'sum',
            'Power Use': 'sum'
        })

        # Rename 'Text Date' to 'Month' to match target schema
        grouped = grouped.rename(columns={'Text Date': 'Month'})

        # Append to list
        dfs.append(grouped)

    # Concatenate all grouped dataframes from all sources
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # After concatenation, there might be duplicate months from different sources
    # Aggregate again by 'Month' summing Water Use and Power Use
    final_df = combined_df.groupby('Month', as_index=False).agg({
        'Water Use': 'sum',
        'Power Use': 'sum'
    })

    # Ensure correct dtypes: Month as string, Water Use as float, Power Use as int
    final_df['Month'] = final_df['Month'].astype(str)
    final_df['Water Use'] = final_df['Water Use'].astype(float)
    final_df['Power Use'] = final_df['Power Use'].astype(int)

    # Write to target CSV
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_62/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    final_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
